title: sub-epic E: Scheduled Tasks folder + durable job chat streams
description:
## Goal
Under Agents, a perpetual Scheduled Tasks group (calendar icon) lists one chat per scheduled job. Every fire appends output to that same chat stream. Chat name = job name. No per-run new chat. No row icon required for those chats initially.

## Domain
- Synthetic group always present (even with zero jobs)
- kind=scheduled_task threads bound via scheduled_job_id
- ensureAgentChatForJob(job): idempotent create-or-return thread titled with job.name
- Fire path (platform fireScheduledTask / agent deliver): append assistant (and tool) events to bound thread_id — never allocate a new thread per run
- Folder icon: CalendarIcon matching Tools → Scheduled tasks

## Implementation guide
1. Extend thread model + BFF/CP (or host) with job_id linkage
2. groupThreadsByProject (or sibling grouper) injects Scheduled Tasks group before/after projects
3. On cron create/update/delete: sync stream chats (create/rename/archive)
4. Wire fire/delivery: resolve job → thread_id → history append + SSE
5. UI: no dither icon for scheduled rows for now; calendar only on folder

## Depends
- lp-jzl operational fire for real runs; offline can mock append
- sub-epic D for create entry UX

## Acceptance
- Folder always visible with calendar icon
- Creating a job creates/selects a chat named after the job under that folder
- Two fires of the same job produce two turns in the same chat (prove with mock or live)
- Deleting/disabling job policy documented (keep history chat vs archive)
close_reason: Sub-epic E complete: E1 job↔thread, E2 Scheduled Tasks folder, E3 fire append all closed. Unblocks G/G1.

title: Portal UI refresh: Agents IA, Tools, scheduled-task streams
description:
## Why
Product UI still reads as generic chat (New chat/New project pair, bubble icons, Scoped to {project}, Settings Overview). Refresh to an Agents mental model with Tools inventory and perpetual scheduled-task agent streams.

## Surfaces
- Product: lanyard-platform portal @lanyard/web (demo.localhost:3010, login dev@demo.local / local-dev-password)
- Demo mock: lanyard-site mock-portal (:3000 landing embed)
- Plan: docs/plans/0013-portal-agents-ui-refresh/overview.md
- UI evidence: artifacts/ui/portal-refresh/
- Related scheduled-tasks epic: lp-jzl (0012)

## User outcomes
1. No "Scoped to X" composer text (project chip stays).
2. Single dark + control → New Chat | New Project | New Scheduled Task.
3. Top selector Chat → Agents; items still called chats.
4. Each agent: dither avatar + LLM name; double-click rename; 2-line row (name + ellipsis subtitle).
5. Settings → Tools; remove Overview; Tools shows type selectors only.
6. Perpetual Scheduled Tasks folder (calendar icon); one chat per job; every run posts to that same chat; names = job names.

## Definition of done
All child sub-epics closed with unit tests + Playwright proof on local product; demo mock parity for visible IA; plan overview Beads section updated with IDs.

## Principles
Experience first; subtract before add; model the domain (AgentChat, job↔thread); idempotent ensure-stream; sequence verifiable units; prove on real artifact (3010 + site mock).

title: Idle reaper: default grace 10 minutes (cost-first stop when inactive)
description:
Change DEFAULT_IDLE_GRACE_MS from 30m to 10m so Daytona sandboxes stop sooner when idle.

Rationale: sandbox is compute while the agent runs; BFF owns chat transcript; stop+retain after short idle cuts vCPU cost. Mid-turn lock still skips reaper during active turns.

Keep:
- IDLE_REAPER_GRACE_MS env override
- retain-on-stop (start_from_stopped re-wake)
- vendor autoStop >> grace (still ~90m safety net)
- mid_turn max hold still > grace

Update unit tests and CP README / idle-reaper docs that hardcode 30 minutes.
acceptance_criteria: DEFAULT_IDLE_GRACE_MS is 10 minutes; tests updated; autoStop still > grace; mid_turn max hold still > grace; docs mention 10m default.
close_reason: DEFAULT_IDLE_GRACE_MS=10m; tests (79) pass idle-reaper/presence/daytona-config/wake-stop-rewake; docs updated (overview, presence, mid-turn, autostop, idle-reaper, CP README). Env IDLE_REAPER_GRACE_MS still overrides. Ordering 10m < 45m mid_turn < 90m autoStop holds.
